Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data extraction error in its final analysis step. It incorrectly stated that Jorge Brum do Canto was born in 1963. The correct birth year retrieved in the previous step was 1910. The Planner confused the film's release year (1963) with the director's birth year. This led to the erroneous conclusion that Monte Hellman (born 1929) was born earlier than Jorge Brum do Canto (incorrectly cited as 1963), whereas in reality, Jorge Brum do Canto (born 1910) was born earlier than Monte Hellman.
